items.title: 13.7 Reducing agents ke taur par halide ions ki nisbati reactivity (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 13.7, printed page 297.

blocks.text: Halide ions ki reducing salahiyat group mein fluoride se iodide tak neeche barhti hai, zyada tar is liye ke electronegativity ghat-ti aur atomic radius barhta hai, kam charge density aur electron dene mein aasani dete hue. Fluoride sab se kamzor aur iodide sab se taqatwar reducing agent hai: I- > Br- > Cl- > F-. Fluorine ki oonchi electronegativity aur apne izafi electron par mazboot pakar F- ke liye electrons dena mushkil banati hai, aur F- ka chhota size oonchi charge density deta hai jo use mazeed mustahkam karti hai. Chloride fluoride se taqatwar magar bromide aur iodide se kamzor reducing agent hai, apne bare size aur kam electronegativity ki wajah se. Bromide chloride se taqatwar hai: bromine kam electronegative hai, aur Br- bara radius aur kam charge density rakhta hai, to aasani se electron khota hai. Iodide dono se kahin taqatwar hai: iodine ki electronegativity bohat kam hai, aur bara I- ion kam charge density aur electron dene ka mazboot rujhan rakhta hai.

blocks.prompt: F- Cl- se kamzor reducing agent hai. Wazahat karein (Quick Check 13.4a).
blocks.explanation: Fluorine sab se electronegative element hai aur fluoride ion nanha hai, to us ka izafi electron nucleus ke qareeb oonchi charge density par bohat mazbooti se pakra hai; use hatana mushkil hai. Chloride bara hai aur chlorine kam electronegative, to us ka bairooni electron dheela pakra hai aur aasani se chhora jata hai, Cl- ko behtar reducing agent banate hue.

items: Reducing taqat I- > Br- > Cl- > F-: group mein neeche electronegativity ghat-ti aur radius barhta hai, charge density ghat-ti hai, aur electron aasani se diya jata hai; X2 ke oxidising rujhan ka ulat.
